summary: Install-time system information and environment exfiltration in @apexfdn/apex
details: install.cjs, referenced by a package lifecycle hook, imports os and https and reads process.env together with host identifiers (including process.platform) at install time. The composition — environment-variable collection combined with OS/host reconnaissance and an outbound HTTPS channel executed automatically on npm install — matches the shape of an install-time exfiltration beacon rather than any documented package functionality. The package advertises no build, native-binary, or configuration purpose that would require reading process.env or transmitting host details during installation.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
